budget_items.what_was_recorded: Road repair and reconstruction is guided by a plan at $800,000.00 per year, noted as a capital need but not included in the FY Plan.
budget_items.quote: is the guideline for all road repairs and/or reconstruction cost at $800,000.00/year

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Street sweeper requested for FY14; outsourcing found very expensive; present sweeper would be a trade-in with little value due to age.
budget_items.quote: the street sweeper is requested for fy14 at $180,000.00.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Engineering study done at the intersection due to safety concerns.
budget_items.quote: an engineering study was done at townsend harbor/mulpus road (cost is $30,000.00).

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Request for a four-way flasher; landscaping removal on private property would be needed, and the owner objects.
budget_items.quote: the owner does not want any removal/trimming of landscaping done on the property (cost is $35,000.00).

budget_items.topic: ADA ramp/walkway, Teen Center to Eagle House
budget_items.what_was_recorded: ADA-compliant ramp/walkway to connect upper and lower level parking; earlier engineered parking plan had high cost and physical problems.
budget_items.quote: there were many physical problems related to the other plans (cost $15,000.00)

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Vehicle requested under a rotation plan to replace a 1994 truck; would not increase the DPW fleet.
budget_items.quote: additional requests explained by mr. rodriquenz are 1-ton pick-up with plow (cost $42,000.00)

budget_items.topic: Demolition of cemetery and park buildings
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Demolition of the cemetery building on Holman Street and the park building on West Street, no longer needed after the new DPW Building.
